editorial_note: Profiles are for a private-friends fantasy league site. Use playful, exaggerated sports-column satire. Treat disputed past events as league lore/jokes, not verified allegations. Avoid insults based on nationality, ethnicity, religion or other protected traits.

managers.name: Robert Tokić
persona: rarely panics after one bad week
running_jokes: Tradegate / controversial-title lore must be framed as old league mythology, not a verified allegation
one title sealed by a Liverpool goalkeeper's 90th-minute goal
Tarik Muharemović = Rolls-Royce
Special One press-conference energy even after defeats
managers.tone: Roast hard. Call back to The Special One branding, lucky-title mythology and old Tradegate lore whenever results allow. If Muharemović is relevant, use Rolls-Royce/garage/engine metaphors and keep the joke football-based.

managers.name: Petar Medić
running_jokes: won the inaugural season and has been chasing the next one ever since
Manchester United comparison: institution and old glory
lost a title to Kristian Radoš on goal difference with equal points
everyone is always available for trade
presidential office, committees, commissions and corporate metaphors
can overthink and over-combine
relationships: Jakov Vrdoljak is his wedding best man / kum and is still happy to attack the president publicly
managers.tone: Use president/front-office/government metaphors, transfer-market chaos and the eternal search for a second title. Treat old governance controversies as archived league banter rather than factual accusations.

managers.name: Ante Babić
running_jokes: success means still setting waivers late in the season
blames fantasy, schedule, injuries and especially draft position
maybe the excuses end when he finally gets first pick
Tottenham comparison: treated as top-tier without trophies
strong opening weeks followed by the eternal question of whether he will still care in GW15
managers.tone: Lean into attendance, waiver participation and excuse-tracking. When he starts hot, frame every win as a test of whether the film will finally make it past the trailer.

managers.name: Marko Mihaljević
persona: Hajduk emotions can outrank Fantasy for an evening
running_jokes: fitness-coach metaphors
conditioning, recovery, reps, bulking and cutting applied to fantasy decisions
clients and training sessions competing with waiver deadlines
if Fantasy goes badly, at least the squad can be beach-ready
managers.tone: Use gym/trainer metaphors often, plus occasional football-fan distraction jokes, but keep real fantasy analysis underneath.

managers.name: Ivan Vrdoljak
persona: not shy about calling himself a doctor of everything when results are good
running_jokes: would be a yo-yo club if relegation existed
best squad in years
Luke Milivojević-era nostalgia
regular target of Tokić's Muharemović propaganda
when form is good, frame it as a possible historic escape from the basement
managers.tone: Frame good runs as a historic escape from the basement and bad runs as gravity restoring order. Use coach/professor language sparingly when it helps the joke.

managers.name: Jakov Vrdoljak
running_jokes: patrolling the lower half of the table
NK Rasulo is sometimes an uncomfortably accurate club name
second season waiting for Wirtz
possible Wirtz family resemblance as a harmless visual gag
bad starts can be declared an intentional navlakuša
claims success is imminent while protecting the basement
relationships: Petar Medić is his wedding best man / kum, which makes anti-president interviews funnier
managers.tone: Police/patrol metaphors are welcome: checkpoints, warrants for points, missing-person reports for form, evidence lockers and patrol routes through the bottom half. Treat navlakuša as a recurring doctrine whenever results are poor.

managers.name: Kristian Radoš
running_jokes: often forgets or ignores waivers
minimal changes
beat Petar Medić to a title on goal difference with equal points
gasi internet dok spava
ancient-phone / strategy-from-2019 jokes
the problem with mocking him is that he has two titles
managers.tone: Contrast old-school patience with everyone else's transaction addiction. When it works, call it wisdom; when it fails, call it refusal to update the software.

managers.name: Karlo Medić
running_jokes: before getting first pick, retirement was always on the table
life is easier with Haaland
last season's strategy: od govana pita
nearly every pickup turned into points
every win without Haaland carrying is evidence for the defence against the Haaland-only allegations
managers.tone: Use golden-touch/luck-vs-skill debates, first-pick privilege and Haaland safety-net jokes. When other players carry him, explicitly note that the prosecution's Haaland-only case has weakened.
